import json
sep=[8]
# Construct 28x28 from 6x6 tile labels, tile dimensions [4]*5+[3]
tiles=[[0,0,3,0,0,0],[2,2,6,2,2,0],[2,0,3,0,0,0],[2,0,3,0,0,0],[0,0,3,0,0,0],[0,0,0,0,0,0]]
sizes=[4,4,4,4,4,3]
out=[]
for tr,h in enumerate(sizes):
    for _ in range(h):
        row=[]
        for tc,w in enumerate(sizes): row += [tiles[tr][tc]]*w + ([8] if tc<5 else [])
        out.append(row)
    if tr<5: out.append([8]*28)
print(len(out),set(map(len,out)))
print(json.dumps({'action':'submit','grid':out},separators=(',',':')))
